## Requiem Beetle (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
 N Gargantuan vermin  

**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 100 ft.; Perception +8  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 31, touch 7, flat-footed 30 (+1 Dex, +24 natural, –4 size)  

**hp** 345 (30d8+210)  

**Fort** +24; **Ref** +11; **Will** +10  

**DR** 10/—; **Immune** acid, mind-affecting effects  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 50 ft.  

**Melee** 2 claws +29 (2d8+11 plus grab), bite +29 (2d10+11)  

**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  

**Special Attacks** constrict (4d6+11), earth-shaking, trample (2d8+16, DC 36)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 33, **Dex** 12, **Con** 24, Int—, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 2  

**Base Atk** +22; **CMB** +37 (+41 grapple); **CMD** 48  

**Feats** Cleave, Power Attack  

**Skills** Acrobatics +1 (+9 jump) Perception +8; **Racial Modifiers** Acrobatics (+8 jump), +8 Perception  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Earth-Shaking (Ex)** Whenever a requiem beetle moves more than 10 feet in a round, all creatures within 10 feet of the requiem beetle must succeed on a DC 34 Reflex save or fall prone. The save DC is Strength-based.  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm mountains and underground  

**Organization** solitary  

**Treasure** none
